title: A Context-Aware Multi-Modal Framework for Asymmetric Risk Control in Student Engagement Analysis
abstract_snippet: The automated engagement classifiers we propose are hampered by the fact that many facial expressions characteristic of negative emotions (furrowed brows, averted gaze, reduced facial expressiveness) are also characteristic of deep cognitive processing.
